"""Defer only repeat progress reads whose original start proof is retained.

The existing construction transport atomically replaces its small ledger before recording
this receipt. First start/completion/error evidence keeps the original barrier.
This helper performs no I/O and grants no action or success credit.
"""
from __future__ import annotations


STEP = "private-query-player-construction-receipt-v1"
TUPLE = ("barony_title_id", "province_id", "building_type_id", "slot_index")


def may_defer_repeated_progress(step, result, *, bridge_pid, actor_id, episode):
    if step != STEP or not isinstance(result, dict):
        return False
    start = result.get("start_receipt")
    if not isinstance(start, dict):
        return False
    if (type(bridge_pid) is not int or bridge_pid <= 0
            or type(actor_id) is not int or actor_id <= 0
            or not isinstance(episode, str) or not episode):
        return False
    request = result.get("action_request_id")
    creation = result.get("post_bridge_creation_date")
    if (not isinstance(request, str) or not request.startswith("construction-submit-")
            or not isinstance(creation, str) or not creation):
        return False
    for receipt in (result, start):
        if (receipt.get("status") != "applied"
                or receipt.get("postcondition_verified") is not True
                or receipt.get("completion_status") != "in_progress"
                or receipt.get("completion_observed_date_raw") is not None
                or receipt.get("action_request_id") != request
                or receipt.get("actor_character_id") != actor_id
                or receipt.get("episode_run_id") != episode
                or receipt.get("post_bridge_pid") != bridge_pid
                or receipt.get("post_bridge_creation_date") != creation
                or type(receipt.get("post_native_revision")) is not int
                or receipt["post_native_revision"] <= 0
                or receipt.get("post_snapshot_id") != f"native:{receipt['post_native_revision']}"
                or type(receipt.get("post_date_raw")) is not int):
            return False
    if (result["post_date_raw"] < start["post_date_raw"]
            or result["post_native_revision"] < start["post_native_revision"]):
        return False
    current_tuple, old_tuple = result.get("candidate"), start.get("candidate")
    if not isinstance(current_tuple, dict) or not isinstance(old_tuple, dict):
        return False
    for key in TUPLE:
        value = current_tuple.get(key)
        if (type(value) is not int or value < (0 if key == "slot_index" else 1)
                or old_tuple.get(key) != value):
            return False
    progress = result.get("construction_progress_observation")
    return bool(isinstance(progress, dict)
        and progress.get("status") == "observed"
        and progress.get("snapshot_id") == result["post_snapshot_id"]
        and progress.get("native_revision") == result["post_native_revision"]
        and progress.get("date_raw") == result["post_date_raw"]
        and type(progress.get("native_remaining_work_raw")) is int
        and progress["native_remaining_work_raw"] >= 0
        and type(progress.get("native_progress_divisor_raw")) is int
        and progress["native_progress_divisor_raw"] > 0)
